abstract: Fan support is a critical component of home advantage across many sports. Whether the impact is on referee decision-making or psychologically affecting opposing teams, fans influence the outcome of games. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the 2020–2021 college basketball season created the opportunity to explore home advantage when few or no fans were allowed to attend games. We exploit large differences in season attendance to measure the impact of fans on home advantage in the season before the pandemic and in an attendance-restricted season during the pandemic. Our results find that a decrease in attendance reduced home advantage. Furthermore, policies restricting attendance during the COVID-19 pandemic more strongly impacted the home advantage in games played by two teams in power conferences relative to games played between two teams in non-power conferences.
abstract_zh: 球迷支持是众多体育项目中主场优势的关键组成部分。无论是影响裁判决策，还是对对手球队产生心理作用，球迷都能左右比赛结果。由于COVID-19疫情，2020-2021赛季的大学篮球赛提供了一个契机，得以在允许极少或没有球迷入场的情况下探究主场优势。我们利用赛季观众人数上的巨大差异，来衡量疫情前赛季及疫情期间限制观众入场的赛季中，球迷对主场优势的影响。研究结果显示，观众人数的减少削弱了主场优势。此外，疫情期间限制观众入场的政策，对两大强联盟球队间比赛的主场优势影响，显著大于非强联盟球队间的比赛。
title: The impact of fans on home advantage: evidence from the covid-19 pandemic college basketball season
title_zh: 新冠疫情赛季中球迷对主场优势的影响：来自大学篮球赛的证据

abstract: Human development is a key driver of economic growth, though its effects can vary across income levels and regional contexts. While prior studies have often focused on specific regions or income groups, comprehensive global analyses remain limited. This study addresses that gap by examining the impact of human development on economic growth using panel data from 2015 to 2022, covering 188 countries. Applying the System-GMM estimation technique, the results reveal that human development has a positive and statistically significant effect on economic growth in middle- and high-income countries, while its impact is not significant in low-income countries. Regional analysis broadly supports the global findings: regions dominated by middle- and high-income countries show significant positive effects, whereas regions with a high proportion of low-income countries exhibit weaker impacts. These findings underscore that the growth-enhancing effects of human development are not uniform, but shaped by income structures and development stages.
abstract_zh: 人类发展是经济增长的关键驱动力，但其影响因收入水平和区域背景而异。尽管以往研究常聚焦于特定区域或收入群体，但全面的全球性分析仍较为有限。本研究利用2015年至2022年涵盖188个国家的面板数据，通过考察人类发展对经济增长的影响来填补这一空白。采用系统广义矩估计法（System-GMM）的分析结果显示，人类发展对中等收入和高收入国家的经济增长具有正向且统计显著的影响，而在低收入国家中其影响并不显著。区域分析总体上支持全球性结论：以中等收入和高收入国家为主的区域表现出显著的正向效应，而低收入国家占比较高的区域则呈现较弱的影响。这些发现强调，人类发展的增长促进效应并非统一不变，而是受收入结构和发展阶段的影响。
title: Human development and economic growth: who benefits the most?
title_zh: 人类发展与经济增长：谁受益最多？

abstract: During the COVID-19 pandemic, US states enacted moratoria on evictions. Leveraging detailed administrative eviction filing data, we analyse the effects of eviction moratoria on eviction filings. Depending on the specification, we estimate that eviction filings declined by 75% in moratorium states relative to states with no moratorium in effect. We then impute the race and gender of renters facing eviction. We find significant and robust reductions in filings for all groups except Asian males. We estimate that eviction moratoria reduced eviction filings for Black, Hispanic and Asian renters significantly more than white renters, and women more than men. The simplest explanation for this disparity is that non-white (female) renters are disproportionately evicted compared to white (male) renters in general, and preventing evictions in a broad, uniform manner would thus disproportionately affect these groups.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情期间，美国各州颁布了暂停驱逐令。利用详细的行政驱逐立案数据，我们分析了暂停驱逐令对驱逐立案的影响。根据不同的模型设定，我们估算出相较于未实施暂停驱逐令的州，实施暂停驱逐令的州的驱逐立案数量下降了75%。随后，我们推断了面临驱逐的租户的种族和性别。研究发现，除亚裔男性外，所有群体的驱逐立案均出现显著且稳健的下降。我们估算，暂停驱逐令对黑人、西班牙裔和亚裔租户的驱逐立案减少幅度显著高于白人租户，对女性的减少幅度高于男性。这一差异的最简单解释是：非白人（女性）租户总体上被驱逐的比例高于白人（男性）租户，因此以广泛、统一的方式阻止驱逐行为会对这些群体产生不成比例的影响。
title: Eviction moratoria and race disparities of eviction filing rates in the U.S
title_zh: 驱逐禁令与美国驱逐申请率的种族差异

abstract: This study evaluates the effect of the Read Liberia intervention that provided teacher training, coaching, and teaching and learning materials, reaching 57,600 grades 1 and 2 students across 640 schools. Exploiting the randomized assignment of schools to the program, we find that Read Liberia improved students’ ability to read a paragraph, doubling oral reading fluency in intervention schools relative to control schools (an effect size of 0.60 standard deviations), and increased their ability to comprehend that paragraph (oral reading comprehension) by 12–13 percentage points, corresponding to an effect size of 0.47 standard deviations. On the basis of the analysis of the program implementation data, teachers’ and students’ surveys, and in-depth classroom observations, we argue that the improvements in reading performance are driven by the availability and utilization of Read Liberia reading materials and not by improved teaching practices in schools. Good-quality reading materials combined with improved instructional practices have the potential to generate even higher effects.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了“利比里亚阅读”干预项目的效果，该项目提供教师培训、辅导及教学与学习材料，覆盖640所学校的57,600名一、二年级学生。利用学校随机分配至项目的机制，我们发现“利比里亚阅读”项目提升了学生朗读段落的能力，使干预学校的口语阅读流利度相对于对照学校翻倍（效应量为0.60个标准差），并提高了他们理解该段落的能力（口语阅读理解），增幅为12至13个百分点，对应效应量为0.47个标准差。基于对项目实施数据的分析、教师与学生调查以及深入的课堂观察，我们认为阅读表现的提升是由“利比里亚阅读”阅读材料的可用性和使用所驱动，而非学校教学实践的改进。高质量的阅读材料结合改进的教学实践，有可能产生更高的效果。
title: Understanding Improvements in Reading Performance in Liberia: Investigating the Centrality of Text
title_zh: 利比里亚阅读表现提升的理解：探究文本的核心作用
